PLANNED SOURCE: GoI DES — Agricultural Statistics at a Glance / district-season yield. DERIVATION: Use district- or state-and-season-specific yield where available; do NOT fall back to national yield when finer data exists. Record year + geography.
PLANNED SOURCE: GoI DES — Cost of Cultivation / Cultivation Practices surveys (CACP CoC). DERIVATION: Use paid-out cost (A2) or A2+FL per study design; state which. State/season specific.

PLANNED SOURCE: AGMARKNET modal mandi price (MSP from CACP for MSP-notified crops as a floor anchor). DERIVATION: Derive representative price from historical modal prices via a documented aggregation rule (e.g. season-median of monthly modal prices over N years, specified market set). Do NOT invent from a range. For MSP crops, record MSP separately as a policy floor, not as the market price.
PLANNED SOURCE: AGMARKNET price series. DERIVATION: CV of the same aggregated price series used for `price`. Document window.

PLANNED SOURCE: AGMARKNET arrivals + processing/consumption studies. DERIVATION: EXPLICITLY a proxy for market-clearing capacity, NOT demand. Derive from arrivals capacity with a documented transformation; never label arrivals 'demand'.
PLANNED SOURCE: ICAR / SAU package-of-practices; DES CoC labour component. DERIVATION: Crop-and-operation specific; state/season where available.

PLANNED SOURCE: ICAR / peer-reviewed water-stress response (FAO-33 Ky as fallback). DERIVATION: Prefer crop-specific Ky (yield response factor) from FAO-33 or ICAR trials.
